date_basis: September 27, 2022 is the first exact publicly dated primary preprint among the cited development of ordinary/total cut complexes. Earlier historical antecedents with only year-level citations are not assigned an invented day.
scientific_integrity: An explicit Forman matching, complete Hasse-acyclicity check and exact integral Morse attaching matrix establish the full homotopy equivalence; modular Alexander-dual ranks are independent corroboration, not an integral proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary three-cut complex of the thirteen-vertex Paley graph; no all-order Paley family theorem, automorphism representation, or independent mathematical audit.
title: Integral mixed-dimensional homotopy of the Paley thirteen-vertex three-cut complex
